Workshop.title: Workshop
Workshop.description: Single active workshop configuration displayed on the public site and edited in /admin.

title.description: Arabic/Darija title of the current workshop.

themeName.description: Display label for the active workshop theme.

themeKey.description: Theme accent key controlling site-wide accent color.

description.description: Darija description of the upcoming workshop.

imageSrc.description: Artwork image path or URL for the workshop.

imageAlt.description: Accessible Arabic description of the workshop image.

slots.description: Exactly two scheduled workshop slots (weekday, dayNumber, month, time).

locationName.description: Display address or venue name where the workshop is held.

locationMapsUrl.description: Google Maps URL pointing to the workshop venue.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last admin update.

Registration.title: Registration
Registration.description: Public workshop registration submission stored privately for team admins.

workshopTitle.description: Title of the workshop registered for.

selectedSlotLabels.description: Human-readable labels of the chosen slots.

artworkNote.description: Optional note or randomly picked surprise motif.

uploadedImageUrl.description: Uploaded reference image URL or compressed data URL.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Workshop participant review moderated by team admins.

photo.description: Optional photo URL of participant work.

approved.description: Whether the review is approved by the team.

SiteAsset.title: SiteAsset
SiteAsset.description: Editable public site image slot (logo, hero girl, intro frames, video poster) or gallery mode marker.

key.description: Fixed slot key such as logo, hero-girl, intro-lighthouse, intro-japan-circle, intro-video-poster, review-starter-1, review-starter-2, review-starter-3, or gallery-seeded.

label.description: Human-readable Arabic label of the asset slot.

src.description: Image path, URL, or compressed JPEG data URL.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

GalleryItem.title: GalleryItem
GalleryItem.description: Framed artwork or workshop behind-the-scenes photo displayed on the Gallery Wall.

src.description: Image path, URL, or compressed JPEG data URL.

title.description: Arabic caption under the wooden frame.

rotationDeg.description: Slight hanging tilt angle in degrees (-12 to 12).

stringDropPx.description: Hanging string length in pixels (12 to 80).

frameColor.description: Hex color of the wooden frame border.

orderIndex.description: Sort order index on the gallery wall (0 to 500).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of creation or last update.

AdminMember.title: AdminMember
AdminMember.description: Authorized team admin member granted access to /admin by an existing admin.

email.description: Lowercase verified Google/Gmail address of the team admin.

name.description: Optional display name or role note identifying the team member.

addedBy.description: Lowercase email of the admin who added this team member.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin was added.

/workshop/{workshopId}.description: Stores the single active workshop document (workshop/current) readable publicly and editable only by admins.

/registrations/{registrationId}.description: Publicly creatable registration entries readable, exportable, and editable only by listed team admins.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Participant reviews: public can submit unapproved reviews (approved=false) and read approved reviews (approved=true); listed team admins can read, approve/unapprove, and delete all reviews.

/site_assets/{assetKey}.description: Publicly readable editable image slots for the landing page; writable only by listed team admins.

/gallery_items/{itemId}.description: Publicly readable framed gallery wall artworks and workshop photos; writable only by listed team admins.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Dynamic team admin emails (document ID is the lowercase email) managed from /admin alongside the bootstrapped primary owner.
